name: io.github.dienhokhanh/ga4-mcp-server
title: Google Analytics 4
description: Run GA4 reports, explore dimensions/metrics and manage GA4 property configuration.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
environmentVariables.description: Path to a Google service account JSON key with Viewer access to your GA4 properties (optional if using browser sign-in or gcloud ADC).

environmentVariables.name: GA4_DEFAULT_PROPERTY
environmentVariables.description: Default GA4 property ID or display name.

environmentVariables.name: GA4_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to enable tools that modify GA4 configuration.
